name: Canvas Palette
description: Provides a kit of styled Single Directory Components for the Canvas (Experience Builder) page builder.
project_description: Canvas Palette ships a kit of ~39 Single Directory Components (SDC) for the Canvas / Experience Builder page builder, inspired by the EPT paragraph suite. Site builders assemble rich pages visually in the Canvas editor; every component is a plain SDC that renders on the front end and stays editable in the Canvas preview. The centrepiece is the Section component, a design wrapper that carries spacing, backgrounds (color, gradient, image, video, slideshow), borders and a CSS grid/flex layout so other components stay focused on their own content. Alongside the components the module heavily augments the Canvas editor form: it groups a Section's ~50 props into collapsible details, draws the margin/border/padding props as an inspector-style DOM box, attaches a Coloris color picker to color props, turns bounded numbers into range sliders, and converts image-style / webform / view text fields into selects. It also adds per-page "Page template" and "Background color" base fields to Canvas pages, with matching page--canvas--STYLE.html.twig templates.
